// scenario for go_perf_layer_runtime_configuration_race_detector_assumed_in_benchmark_numbers: Layer: Build and runtime configuration. Flag benchmark guidance or scripts that compare race-enabled and normal builds directly.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
// Run with: go test -bench=. -race . (reported as ~2500 ns/op, but race detector adds overhead)

func scenario587BenchmarkFetch(b *testing.B) {
	cache := make(map[string]int, 256)
	var mu sync.Mutex
	b.ResetTimer()
	b.RunParallel(func(pb *testing.PB) {
		for pb.Next() {
			mu.Lock()
			cache["key"]++
			_ = cache["key"]
			mu.Unlock()
		}
	})
}
